name: Whole Milk (3.25%)
description: Whole cow's milk is a highly complex, nutrient-dense liquid matrix designed by nature for complete biological support. It delivers an exceptionally bioavailable pool of structural proteins, essential fatty acids, and a premier mineral network engineered for bone and metabolic architecture.

macroNutrients.name: Calories
macroNutrients.description: Provides balanced energy density derived from a natural ratio of healthy dietary fats, proteins, and carbohydrates.

macroNutrients.name: Protein
macroNutrients.description: An elite complete protein source consisting of 80% casein and 20% whey, delivering all essential amino acids for optimal muscle synthesis and cellular repair.

macroNutrients.name: Total Fat
macroNutrients.description: Composed of complex saturated, monounsaturated, and natural trans-fats (CLA) that serve as critical building blocks for cellular membranes and hormone pathways.

macroNutrients.name: Carbohydrates
macroNutrients.description: Consists entirely of lactose, a naturally occurring disaccharide sugar that provides steady glycemic energy and assists in intestinal mineral absorption.

microNutrients.name: Calcium
microNutrients.description: The gold standard of bioavailable calcium, deeply embedded in a phosphoprotein matrix for seamless integration into the skeletal framework and teeth.

microNutrients.name: Vitamin B12 (Cobalamin)
microNutrients.description: An essential animal-derived vitamin critical for the maintenance of the myelin sheath in the nervous system and the synthesis of red blood cells.

microNutrients.name: Vitamin B2 (Riboflavin)
microNutrients.description: Plays a vital role as a coenzyme in cellular energy production cascades, mitochondrial health, and the metabolism of fats and carbohydrates.

microNutrients.name: Phosphorus
microNutrients.description: Works in a strict synergistic loop with calcium to build strong bone tissue matrices and form ATP molecules for cellular energy currency.

microNutrients.name: Potassium
microNutrients.description: An essential intracellular electrolyte that helps modulate fluid equilibrium, nerve transmissions, and steady cardiovascular muscle tone.

microNutrients.name: Vitamin D
microNutrients.description: Often fortified or naturally present in trace fats, it acts as a master hormone to unlock hyper-efficient intestinal calcium absorption channels.

healthBenefits: Elite Bone Mineralization Dynamics: The highly structured combination of calcium, phosphorus, and milk proteins creates a synergistic matrix that aggressively locks minerals into bones, drastically maximizing skeletal density.

Muscle Synthesis & Cellular Recovery: The dual-action protein delivery of fast-digesting whey and slow-release casein ensures a sustained, continuous pool of circulating plasma amino acids, perfect for suppressing muscle breakdown.

Metabolic Optimization with CLA: Natural whole milk contains Conjugated Linoleic Acid (CLA), which clinical data suggests can support metabolic efficiency, immune resilience, and the modulation of body fat profiles.

Neurological Coenzyme Support: Robust levels of Riboflavin (B2) and Cobalamin (B12) work directly to maintain cellular energy pathways and defend nervous system tissue integrity from oxidative decline.
precautions: Lactose Intolerance Matrix: Whole milk contains natural lactose sugar. Individuals with a genetic deficiency of the lactase enzyme will experience gastrointestinal distress, bloating, cramps, or gas due to bacterial fermentation in the colon.

Cow's Milk Protein Allergy (CMPA): Distinct from lactose intolerance, this is an immune-mediated response to alpha-s1 casein or beta-lactoglobulin proteins. It can trigger systemic inflammatory markers, skin hives, or digestive complications.

Saturated Fat Management Parameters: Because whole milk contains bio-active saturated lipids, individuals tracking strict lipid profiles or managing severe cardiovascular parameters should balance their total daily consumption vectors.

Industrial Antibiotic & Hormone Tracking: Depending on commercial agricultural sourcing, conventionally processed milk may retain trace environmental residues. Opting for clean, organic, or high-grade local processing ensures maximum purity.
